youtube.title: He Bought Google.com For $12 (True Story) 😳
youtube.description:
In 2015, Sanmay Ved, a former Google employee, typed google.com into Google Domains at about 1 a.m. It said available, for $12. He bought it, and for about a minute he owned google.com: messages for the site's owners landed in his inbox. Then Google cancelled the order and refunded the $12.

He reported it, and Google's security reward programme paid him $6,006.13 (read it as 6-0-0-6-1-3: G-O-O-G-L-E). He asked for it to go to the Art of Living India Foundation, which runs free schools in India, so Google doubled it to over $12,000.

What would YOU do with google.com for one minute? 👇

A true story, animated Roblox-style. Follow viralrobloxgames for more stories like this.
